# The Astral Shadow-Clans — Draft Datasheets

*Owned verb: **AGONY** · generated by `unit_calculator.py faction` · ×1.5 scale · stat line = MOV · MS · RS · ARM · MIGHT · CTRL*

**Core trait — Agony Harvest:** Start the battle with 2 Agony (max 4). Gain 1 each time an enemy unit is destroyed. When a unit activates, spend 1 Agony to Empower it until the end of the activation: re-roll Hit rolls, +1 PEN in melee and +2″ to Charge rolls. Agony is your own resource; it is never placed on enemy units.

**Gamble — All-In Assassination** *(risk: resource)*: Once per battle, spend ALL Agony (minimum 2) when a unit activates: its weapons gain [PRECISION] and [SHREDDING WOUNDS] this activation; you cannot gain Agony again until the End of Round.

**Army-wide rules (priced into every unit):** *Agony: Empower* — About 1 activation in 5. · *Agony: Edge* — +1 PEN melee when empowered.

## Detachment — Skysplinter Raiders

*Skiffs and barges deliver strike teams, then fly on.*

**Detachment rule:** Skysplinter Assault: units that disembarked this round get +1 to Wound and [CRASHING].

**Enhancements**
- **Umbral Veil** (+20 pts, Master of the Astral Edge): WARD 3+ until the first time a WARD roll of 1 is made, then no WARD.
- **Agony-Tap** (+10 pts, Flesh-Sculptor): Start the battle with 3 Agony.

**Stratagems**
- **Lightning Raid** (1 CP) — *A transport moves:* Embarked units may disembark after its move and still Charge.
- **Splinter Storm** (1 CP) — *A unit Shoots:* Weapons gain [ANTI-INFANTRY 3+].
- **Skiff Dive** (1 CP) — *A [FLY] unit is targeted:* −1 to Hit.

## Detachment — Cyber-Ronin

*Sword-saints and duelists in the open, no transports.*

**Detachment rule:** Way of the Blade: melee weapons gain [STRIKE FIRST] on a round the unit charged; units that spend Agony also gain [PRECISION].

**Enhancements**
- **Ancestral Blade** (+15 pts, Cyber-Ronin Sword-Saint): +1 Damage in melee on a round he charged.
- **Duelist's Discipline** (+10 pts, Cyber-Ronin Duelists): Enemies get −1 to Hit them in melee.

**Stratagems**
- **Draw and Cut** (1 CP) — *A unit is charged:* Its Retaliation Strike resolves before the charger fights.
- **Kensei** (1 CP) — *A unit destroys an enemy Leader:* Gain 2 Agony.
- **Bladestorm** (1 CP) — *A unit is selected to Fight:* Its melee weapons gain [REAPING 1].

## Detachment — Venom Cabal

*Poison gunlines and flesh-sculptors.*

**Detachment rule:** Venom: ranged weapons with [IMPALING HITS] also gain [ANTI-INFANTRY 4+]; Flesh-Sculptors heal D3 MIGHT on the attached unit at the End of Round.

**Enhancements**
- **Elixir of Agony** (+15 pts, Flesh-Sculptor): Friendly units within 6″ get +1 to Wound in melee on a round they charged.
- **Hex-Venom Rounds** (+10 pts, Shadow-Kabar Raiders): +1 PEN with ranged weapons.

**Stratagems**
- **Toxin Cloud** (1 CP) — *A unit Shoots:* Units hit suffer −1″ MOV until the End of Round.
- **Pain-Fuelled** (1 CP) — *An Agony is spent:* Heal 1 MIGHT on the empowered unit.
- **Lethal Dose** (1 CP) — *A unit targets a Class 1 unit:* Re-roll Wound rolls.
